**Finding submitted: deviation (T4C), preferred target.**

- **What the document does:** § 6(a) allows convenience termination by either party only "[a]t any time that there is no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding," on 15 days' notice. § 6(b) is a breach-only right. There is no fixed term, no early-termination fee, and no refund mechanic anywhere in the agreement.
- **Why it fails fallback:** we have no convenience exit while any engagement is live, and no pro-rata refund of prepaid fees.
- **Vendor side is already acceptable:** the same "no uncompleted Statement of Work outstanding" gate prevents Contractor from walking away mid-engagement, so that preferred element is mapped as already met and left untouched — I did not flag the mutual 15-day right, which is benign when no work is outstanding.
- **Redline:** a single inserted § 6(c) giving Company alone the right to terminate this Agreement or any Statement of Work on 30 days' written notice with a pro-rata refund of prepaid fees. No partial-termination language, penalties, or ancillary tails added.
